summary: @or-sdk/deployer preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The preinstall lifecycle script (setup.mjs) downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js via execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')]). math_init.js is a 727KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle using string-array rotation (WV8StW accessor over a shuffled numeric constants array) and hex-mangled identifiers (MmgoCP, etDiOOB), making its behavior unauditable. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated in obfuscator.io style, with hex-mangled import bindings (_0x488df8 for fs, _0x52943e for https, _0x548d91 for zlib) and per-function string-lookup maps rather than plain identifiers. The declared purpose of the package is a deployer SDK; there is no documented build reason to fetch a second language runtime at npm install time solely to execute an opaque bundled payload. The obfuscated preinstall + obfuscated Bun-only payload structure gives the publisher arbitrary code execution on any installer's machine on npm install, and the payload contents can be changed silently between versions without any visible source change.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
